name: Websol Energy System Ltd
about: Websol Energy System Limited is engaged in the business of manufacturing photovoltaic crystalline solar cells and related modules in India. [1]
keyPoints:
Products
The company is a leading manufacturer of high-quality solar cells and modules, which serve as critical components in the development of utility-scale power plants, as well as rooftop and commercial & industrial (C&I) solar power installations. [1]

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 68.5% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Stock is trading at 12.2 times its book value
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 88.1% of their holding.
